guide.title: Permissions & Operational Guide
guide.desc: Ensure TitanBot has the following Discord permissions to manage support tickets seamlessly:
guide.permManageChannels: Manage Channels: Allows provisioning private ticket channels and moving them to closed categories.
guide.permViewChannels: View Channels: To read panel interactions and ticket room messages.
guide.permSendMessages: Send Messages: To send welcome messages, staff controls, and system notifications.
guide.permEmbedLinks: Embed Links: Mandatory to render formatted information cards.
guide.permManageMessages: Manage Messages: To pin guidelines or clean up panel posts if needed.
guide.step1Text: A member clicks the panel button and TitanBot instantly creates a private text channel.
guide.step2Text: Your support staff role is granted access with dedicated action controls.
guide.step3Text: A staff member can claim the ticket to coordinate directly with the member.
guide.step4Text: On closing, an HTML transcript is archived on the Dashboard and the user is sent a DM confirmation.
